label: Professional
summary: Objective, authoritative, and respectful business tone
Balanced sentence structure with precise terminology
No overly casual colloquialisms or flippant remarks
writing_style: Structured corporate prose using standard business English and complete grammatical phrasing.
messaging_principles: Present assertions with balanced evidence and professional restraint.

rules.title: Avoid Overly Casual Slang in Professional Communications
rules.description: Maintain a dignified corporate standard by replacing slang or flippant phrases with formal business expressions.

suggested_replacements.what's up: we are writing to update you

rules.do_example: We appreciate your continued partnership and are pleased to share our annual summary.
rules.dont_example: Hey guys, what's up! Check out this totally epic update that rocks!
